thread:
Jon - Sales: Quick heads-up: Acme wants to start a 2-week POC next Wed. They need a Dedicated pool (8x A100 equiv) and temporary surge headroom for demo spikes. Also need ephemeral API keys and VPC peering for logs/metrics. Can we provision today? cc @Tess @Alex

Tess (SE): We can do the pool + surge policy. For POCs we normally grant a 48h high-burst window and ephemeral creds. Do they want autoscaling or fixed reserve? I propose autoscale with min_replicas:2, max_replicas:12, target_rps_per_replica:400, burst_headroom_percent:40. Note model choice affects p99 latency.

Alex (Infra): I'll need billing contact, ACME VPC CIDR, and KMS ARN. Also who signs the temporary LOI for credits. I can create the pool after approvals.

Maria (PM): Pricing: we can offer $5k POC credits at 50% discount; excess billed standard. Need finance approval to attach credits.

Jon - Sales: Billing contact: acme-billing@acme.com. VPC CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16. KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456. They want least-priv ephemeral key scoped to generate:write + embeddings:read, TTL 72h. SLA ask: p99 <300ms with quantized medium model. Feasible?

Tess (SE): Ephemeral key + TTL ok. For p99 <300ms: short prompts on quantized gpt-medium-quant in a warm dedicated pool with KV caching should work. Recommend 30m warmup, enable prefix/KV caching, fallback to smaller hosted model on saturation.

infra-bot: Ticket #INF-2346 created: dedicate-pool-acme-poc. Assigned Alex (Infra). ETA provisioning after approvals: ~4h.

Alex (Infra): Provisional pool rp-ACME-2026 created (provisioning). Reserved surge buffer of 4 GPUs for 48h pending LOI. Internal endpoint rp-acme.internal.redwood.net. Ephemeral key placed in vault; shared with Tess and Jon. Jon please upload LOI and cc finance.

Jon - Sales: LOI uploaded at 1819990200. They also request TLS client cert for peering. Who handles certs?

Tess (SE): Ops handles peering certs. Alex, please open cert request and start tls negotiation. Smoke test we’ll use:

```
curl -X POST https://rp-acme.internal.redwood.net/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEMERAL_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-medium-quant","input":"hello"}'
```

Alex (Infra): Cert request CERT-778 opened. Pool warmup started (pulling weights). Expected ready ~2.5h. Surge buffer reserved. If finance approves credits will mark pool active.

Maria (PM): Looping finance. Will try to approve within 90m and attach discount metadata.

Jon - Sales: Thanks all. Will run demo smoke test after Alex confirms pool ready. :thumbsup:

Alex (Infra): Will update ticket and add checklist (VPC peering, KMS policy, ephemeral key TTL).
